changelog: **`/admin/weekly-reports` — the term compliance matrix, chase-up, export and the accreditation booklet** (#1918, story #1916). One screen answers "every intern's submission status this term": filters (cohort, mentor, company, status — facets from one capped query — plus a name search with its own `data-testid`), a summary band (interns, submission rate, fully up to date, 2+ weeks missing), and a matrix with one row per intern and one cell per owed week — approved / handed in / changes requested / draft / missing, each a colour **and** a letter so it survives a black-and-white print, late hand-ins ringed — with a legend. The week columns scroll in their own (positioned) container; the page body never scrolls sideways at 360px in German, and the route joins the mobile-layout audit. Clicking an intern opens a read-only week-by-week drill-down (summary, hours, blockers, mentor comment — no input anywhere). **Chase-up**: `POST /api/admin/weekly-reports/remind` is the Friday reminder narrowed to a selection — `sendWeeklyReportReminders()` gained a `relationIds` option and returns who it reminded — so the same eligibility and the same per-week `WeeklyReportReminder` claim apply: a second click, or a click after Friday's run, sends nothing; rows show "Reminded this week" from that marker, and every chase-up is an `admin.weekly_report.chase` activity entry. **Export**: XLSX with a matrix sheet and a per-week detail sheet; **print**: A4 landscape stylesheet. **Booklet**: `/weekly-reports/booklet/[relationId]` — a cover (intern, company, mentor, cohort, period, total hours, owed vs handed-in weeks, two signature lines) then every owed week with its text and mentor comment; a page to print to PDF, no PDF library. Admin-only, `mentorship`-gated (gatePage, the API, the nav link). All numbers come from `src/lib/weeklyReportCompliance.ts` (#1917); the export is built from the same rows until the report registry (#1903) exists. EN/TR/DE (`adminWeeklyReports`, MARKETING-leak exempt with its reason). Also: `/admin/acquisition` added to the mobile-layout coverage list, whose gate was red on main since #2702.

en: Coordinators get a new Weekly reports screen: every intern’s weekly reports for the term in one matrix, a reminder for those who are behind (never sent twice in a week), an Excel export and a printable report booklet per intern.
